description: This file defines an interface 'IRenderer' in the PhpSpreadsheet library, within the Chart Renderer namespace. It declares methods for constructing a renderer with a Chart object and rendering the chart to a specified file.

classes.name: IRenderer
classes.description: An interface for rendering charts within PhpSpreadsheet, requiring implementing classes to define constructor and render methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that takes a Chart object to initialize the renderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the chart to a given filename or stream, returning true on success.
